assumptions: A marked limit line is present as stop_line, so the 'if marked' branch applies; the 'otherwise before entering the crosswalk' and 'if there is no limit line or crosswalk at the entrance' alternatives are out of scope with no geometry and are not checked.
'shall stop' with no stated duration is interpreted as dwelling continuously stationary at max_speed 0.05 for 500 ms inside stop_zone.
The required stop must occur in stop_zone, the last 10 metres before the limit line, and precede the first inbound crossing of stop_line.
Only inbound approach crossings mapped to to_right (+y) trigger the obligation; vehicles never crossing inbound pass vacuously.
Stop-sign presence and intersection context are not detectable, so the check is applied to every vehicle that crosses stop_line inbound.
Anchor is center because top-down box centre is metric position while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge, not wheels.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped stationary in the stop zone.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
